notes: Cash equivalents: the schedule prints the money-market fund below 'Total Investments' (the balance-sheet investments line equals that total and includes the U.S. Treasury bill; the money fund sits in 'Cash and cash equivalents'). The filer files an undimensioned CashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for that total only from 2025-12-31 (9,794 = 'Total Cash Equivalents $ 9,794'), so the six earlier quarters take the printed figure. First income year 2024: 0000950170-25-045206 (10-K, 2024-12-31) 'the Company commenced investment operations on May 7, 2024' and 'For the Year Ended December 31, 2024 Total investment income $ 25,722 Net expenses 16,123 Net investment income 9,599'; 0000950170-24-127235 (10-Q, 2024-09-30) 'Total investment income 9,058 12,451' (quarter, nine months). The 10-Q for 2024-03-31 prints a dash for income and tags none, so the year had two quarters with income and three filed; the fourth quarter was published as 25,722 / 4 = 6,431 (net investment income 9,599 / 4 = 2,400). With the first quarter nil (nil_income_quarters) it is 25,722 less 12,451 = 13,271 (net investment income 9,599 less 4,989 = 4,610). first_income_year_ends does not apply: the first quarter was filed.
